# Hrizn for Gemini CLI and Google Antigravity

![Google Antigravity](assets/antigravity.svg)

Talk to your Hrizn dealership data from **Gemini CLI** or **Google Antigravity**.
After a one-time sign-in, you can ask about live inventory, published content,
IdeaCloud research, OEM ad compliance, reviews, social posts, and local market
pricing — without leaving the agent you already use.

**MCP URL:** `https://mcp.app.hrizn.io/mcp`

You do not need an API key. Both products use OAuth. Hrizn registers the client
automatically (Dynamic Client Registration).

---

## 1. Save a dealership grant first

Do this once in Hrizn. Skipping it is the most common “no tools” failure.

1. Sign in at [app.hrizn.io](https://app.hrizn.io).
2. Open **MCP** in the left navigation.
3. Select at least one dealership and **Save**.

Granted rooftops need **Teams or higher with API Access**. Hrizn Market Maker
and Social Hub publishing need **Unlimited** on that grant.

Full product guide: [Hrizn MCP](https://api-docs.hrizn.io/guides/hrizn-mcp).

---

## 2. Install

Pick the product you use. You can install both.

### Gemini CLI

Install straight from GitHub. Use the full URL — `gemini extensions install`
takes a git URL or a local path, not an `owner/repo` shorthand:

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/Horizn-Cloud/hrizn-antigravity-plugin
```

From a local clone:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Horizn-Cloud/hrizn-antigravity-plugin.git
gemini extensions install ./hrizn-antigravity-plugin
```

Confirm it loaded:

```bash
gemini extensions list
```

You should see `hrizn` with one MCP server and the `hrizn-mcp` skill.

### Google Antigravity (IDE or CLI)

**Antigravity CLI** (recommended):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Horizn-Cloud/hrizn-antigravity-plugin.git
agy plugin install ./hrizn-antigravity-plugin
agy plugin list
```

**Antigravity IDE / Antigravity 2.0** — copy the whole folder (keep
`plugin.json`, `mcp_config.json`, and `skills/` together):

| Where it should live | Path |
| --- | --- |
| All workspaces | `~/.gemini/config/plugins/hrizn/` |
| This workspace only | `.agents/plugins/hrizn/` or `_agents/plugins/hrizn/` |
| Antigravity CLI (if not using `agy plugin install`) | `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugins/hrizn/` |

Restart Antigravity after copying.

**Or add the server by hand** in Settings → MCP Servers → View raw config
(`~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json` or `.agents/mcp_config.json`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hrizn": {
      "serverUrl": "https://mcp.app.hrizn.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Use `serverUrl` here — not `url` or `httpUrl`. Gemini CLI uses `httpUrl` in
`gemini-extension.json`; Antigravity uses `serverUrl` in `mcp_config.json`.

---

## 3. Sign in (OAuth)

### Gemini CLI

Authentication happens inside a session, not from a shell subcommand. Start
Gemini and run the `/mcp auth` slash command:

```bash
gemini
```

```text
/mcp auth hrizn
```

Your browser opens for Hrizn sign-in. When it completes, Gemini CLI restarts the
server and the Hrizn tools appear. Run `/mcp` any time to see connection status,
and `/mcp auth hrizn` again if your session expires.

If the browser does not open, restart with `gemini -d` — debug mode prints the
full authorization URL so you can paste it yourself.

### Antigravity

1. Open **Settings → Customizations** (IDE) or run `/mcp` (CLI).
2. Find **hrizn** in installed MCP servers.
3. Click **Authenticate**.
4. Sign in at Hrizn in the browser. If Antigravity asks for an authorization
   code, paste it back into the app.

Tokens stay on your machine and refresh automatically.

---

## 4. Try it

- “Which rooftops am I connected to? Brief me on lot aging for the primary store.”
- “Find 2024–2025 RAV4s under $40,000 and outline a landing page from dealer context.”
- “Check this ad copy for OEM compliance. Don’t apply fixes until I confirm.”
- “Draft replies to unanswered one- and two-star reviews and publish only what I approve.”
- “Compare local days supply and flag price-cut candidates for 90-day trucks.”

Writes (publish, delete, review replies, social posts) ask for confirmation
first. That is expected.

---

## Troubleshooting

| What you see | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `mcp_grant_required` or no tools | Save a dealership on **MCP** in Hrizn, then authenticate again. |
| OAuth page, then still no tools | Confirm the grant is saved for the **same** Hrizn user you signed in as. |
| Antigravity has no Authenticate button | Confirm `mcp_config.json` uses `serverUrl` and has no placeholder client id or API key. |
| `Install source not found.` | Pass the full URL: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Horizn-Cloud/hrizn-antigravity-plugin`. The `owner/repo` shorthand is not accepted. |
| Gemini CLI installed it but shows no Hrizn tools | Run `/mcp auth hrizn` inside a `gemini` session, then `/mcp` to confirm it is connected. |
| Market or social writes denied | Those need **Unlimited** on the granted rooftop. Reads still work on Teams+ with API Access. |
| A write asks for approval | Approve only after you review the proposed change. |

Need a human? [hrizn.io/support](https://hrizn.io/support)
